summary: Phase 5 dispatch (Wave B, fuel-raise): implemented `intFuel φ := 3 ^ (2*(2*φ.complexity+1)*(φ.complexity+2))` in Expansion.lean exactly per report 07 §Q4, wired both `intuitionisticTableau` and `minimalTableau` to it (confirmed no separate Minimal/Expansion.lean exists -- both call sites live in Intuitionistic/Expansion.lean at lines 467/480). Expansion.lean built GREEN in isolation (658 jobs). Audited downstream: Soundness.lean (both Intuitionistic and Minimal) is UNAFFECTED -- it invokes `simp only [intuitionisticTableau] at h` then applies the fuel-generic lemma `intExpandBranches_closed_unsat`, confirmed by direct read (Soundness.lean:1706-1745) and by scoped build (both Soundness modules stayed GREEN throughout). HOWEVER, `Completeness.lean` broke: `openBranch_countermodel` (Scheme.lean:1759-1785) and `tableau_complete` (Scheme.lean:1815-1824+) -- both consumed by `intuitionisticTableau_complete`/`minimalTableau_complete` -- hardcode the OLD fuel literal `2 ^ (2 * φ.complexity + 2)` directly in their type signatures (also `tableau_sound` at Scheme.lean:252, though that one is not on the Completeness.lean failure path since it is soundness-only). This is DIFFERENT from Soundness.lean's generic pattern: these three Scheme.lean lemmas are NOT parametric over fuel, so raising `intuitionisticTableau`'s fuel makes its unfolded type stop unifying with `tableau_complete`'s hardcoded-fuel conclusion (concrete error captured: 'Application type mismatch' at Completeness.lean:104 against `openBranch_countermodel`, and 'could not unify the conclusion of tableau_complete' at Completeness.lean:126). Scheme.lean is explicitly fenced off as Phase 6 territory (do-not-edit) for this dispatch, and unlike Soundness.lean/task-316, no mechanical-fix carve-out was authorized for Scheme.lean in this dispatch's territory contract. Per the STOP-gate/territory discipline, the Expansion.lean edit was THEREFORE REVERTED (git checkout) to keep the shared branch (task-441-native-refactor, concurrently used by other agents) green -- `git status` confirms Expansion.lean is clean; only two unrelated files (.orchestrator-loop-guard, 476's zulip-coordination.md, both owned by other concurrent processes) show as modified. NO commit was made this dispatch since nothing survives to commit. Attempted to coordinate with the named concurrent agent t317-impl-1 via SendMessage but it returned 'no transcript found' (not currently resumable/addressable) -- coordination could not be completed live; the fix is fully specified below for the next dispatch or for folding into Phase 6.

blockers.target: Phase 5: raise fuel to intFuel φ
blockers.verbatim_goal: Raise the tableau fuel from 2^(2*φ.complexity+2) to intFuel φ (a 3^Θ(c²) bound), and re-verify every downstream fuel-pinned caller still builds. Define intFuel φ := 3 ^ (2*(2*φ.complexity+1)*(φ.complexity+2))... Change the fuel site at Expansion.lean:466 and any minimal analogue.
blockers.root_cause: Scheme.lean hardcodes the pre-existing fuel literal `2 ^ (2 * φ.complexity + 2)` directly (not via a call to intuitionisticTableau/minimalTableau) in 4 locations across 3 theorems: tableau_sound (Scheme.lean:252, in the hypothesis type), openBranch_countermodel (Scheme.lean:1762, in the hypothesis type), and tableau_complete (Scheme.lean:1819 in the conclusion type, and :1822 in the proof's `cases hresult : ...` term). Completeness.lean's intuitionisticTableau_complete/minimalTableau_complete apply openBranch_countermodel/tableau_complete against intuitionisticTableau's/minimalTableau's unfolded (simp-exposed) type, which after the fuel raise no longer syntactically matches these hardcoded conclusions -- a genuine type mismatch, not merely a presentation issue (intFuel φ and 2^(2*φ.complexity+2) are different Nat-valued terms, not defeq).
blockers.why_out_of_territory: Scheme.lean is explicitly designated Phase 6 territory (do-not-edit) in this dispatch's H7 contract, with no mechanical-fix carve-out analogous to the one explicitly granted for Soundness.lean/task-316. Editing it here would violate the territory contract even though the fix itself is textually mechanical (4 literal substitutions, zero proof-tactic changes needed since all 4 sites are opaque hypothesis/conclusion positions).
